Miguel Callahan
miguel.callahan510@example.com | Minneapolis, MN
Miguel Callahan has 9 years of experience in backend and distributed systems.
Most recently, Staff Backend Engineer at Crestline Solutions (2024-2026), where
they applied distributed-systems patterns to scale the platform to 233K
concurrent users. Before that, Senior Backend Engineer at Crestline
Technologies (2022-2024). Before that, Backend Engineer at Bedrock Software
(2017-2022). Education: B.S. Information Systems, SMU, 2017. Core skills:
Node.js, PostgreSQL, TypeScript, GraphQL, AWS, RabbitMQ, Java.
